    - text: "This example showcases how to map midi controller parameters / to for instance visual effects. / Right now a few controls are available: if you want to use your / own controller, right-click on th MIDI In and press "Learn" & move / them : score will list the ones it discovers. / If you don't see any, try editing the device and selecting your actual / MIDI device instead. / Once you see your controls moving in the explorer, you can assign / them to any controls of any shader, effect, etc. / Here, the modulation wheel CC1 is assigned to "zoom" and the pitch / whel to amplitude and rotation. / The velocity of Note ON 36 (C2) is assigned to triside1. / To add or change controls, either click on the port and select one or type its address, / or drag it from the explorer to the port (the little green circle will become larger if it can / handle this address. / Since MIDI controls have known min / max (0-127) and this shader's controls / too, score automatically maps the range of one to another. / To have more control, use Micromap objects which allow to add simple / math expressions."
